title: 第5章 测灵根第6章 青龙河
content_zh:
归元宗，坐落于镜州中部的归元山脉，门下弟子上万人，是镜州最大的修行宗门，素有正道领袖的美称。
整条山脉巍峨起伏，支脉繁多，雄峰与林海交错，霞光与仙鹤齐舞，仿若人间仙境。
这日清晨，归元宗南边一座山间广场上，出现三道身影。
走在最前面的是一位青袍老人，后面跟着一个矮胖少年，以及一个身形消瘦、半边脸颊漆黑的青年男子。
三人一路不停，径直来到了那座悬挂着“引仙堂”匾额的石殿之中。
“管事大人，您回来了。”
殿中有一青年修士，见到青袍老者进门，连忙上来行礼。
“嗯。”
张仙长点头道。
“他俩是老夫在双河镇寻来的仙苗，你给他们做一下入门登记吧。”
“好的。”
青年修士恭敬答应。
然后从墙壁的抽屉中取出一枚玉镜，对韩林和岳青山道：
“登记之前，我要测一测你们的灵根品阶，如果灵根上好，便有望得到宗门破格培养，如果灵根一般，那便只能从底层做起，靠自己一步步往上爬了。”
岳青山道：“敢问前辈，什么样的灵根算好呢？”
青年修士道：“灵根天赋好坏，跟其纯度有关。单属性灵根者，在修行界被称为天灵根，修炼起来无比轻松，消耗的资源也最少。”
“双灵根者，被称为地灵根，修炼起来也挺快的，但相比于天灵根却逊色不少。”
“三灵根者，就是普通灵根了，绝大部分人都在此列，需要有大机缘，方可从人群中脱颖而出。”
“至于三灵根以下，四灵根五灵根，那就不用说了，这种在修行界被称为伪灵根和杂灵根。”
“伪灵根者，若有逆天机缘，或许还有望筑基。”

“可杂灵根之人，别说筑基了，穷极一生恐怕也只能在练气三层以下徘徊。”
说到此处，青年修士微微一笑道：“总而言之，就是灵根属性越少，天赋就越好。”
“原来如此啊。”
岳青山恍然地点了点头。
韩林倒是神色平静，因为早在鸡鸣观时，他就已经听枯血老人说过灵根品阶之事了。
只是那枯血老人并无检测灵根的手段，所以还不知道，自己究竟是何种天赋而已。
这时，青年修士将手中玉镜，朝岳青山递了过去：“这便是检测灵根属性的通灵宝鉴，你把手贴在上面吧。”
“是，师兄。”
岳青山闻言，连忙伸出手，轻轻贴在玉镜表面。
韩林举目望去，只见那玉镜周围的珠子，接连亮了起来，先是金色，然后是红色，最后是棕色。
但三颗之后就再也没有任何动静。
“金木土三灵根，不算好，但也不算最差。”张仙长见状，微笑着点了点头，看起来还算满意。
“前辈，那我这灵根能破格培养吗？”岳青山神色一喜，朝张仙长望去。
“不行，三灵根只是普通灵根，还达不到破格培养的条件，得从杂役弟子做起，不过你若肯努力，这辈子还是有希望筑基的！”
“这样啊。”
岳青山微微失望了一下，又坚定道：“我一定会努力的！”
“嗯。”
张仙长点点头，又对青年修士道：“小何，赶紧给韩林也测了吧，老夫有些乏了，早点弄完回去休息一下。”
“好的。”
content_en:
Guiyuan Sect, located in the Guiyuan Mountains in the middle of Jingzhou, has tens of thousands of disciples. It is the largest practicing sect in Jingzhou and is known as the leader of the righteous path.
The entire mountain range is majestic and undulating, with many branches, majestic peaks and forest seas intertwined, and the glow and cranes dance together, just like a fairyland on earth.
Early that morning, three figures appeared in a mountain square south of Guiyuan Sect.
Walking at the front was an old man in a green robe, followed by a short and fat boy, and a thin young man with half of his cheeks dark.
The three of them walked straight to the stone hall with the plaque "Yinxian Hall" hanging on it.
"Master Steward, you are back."
There was a young monk in the hall. When he saw the old man in green robes entering the door, he quickly came up to salute.
"Yeah."
Zhang Xianchang nodded.
"They are the fairy seedlings I found in Shuanghe Town. Please register them for entry."
"Okay."
The young monk respectfully agreed.
Then he took out a jade mirror from the drawer on the wall and said to Han Lin and Yue Qingshan:
"Before registering, I want to test the level of your spiritual roots. If your spiritual roots are good, you can expect to be specially trained by the sect. If your spiritual roots are average, you can only start from the bottom and work your way up step by step."
Yue Qingshan said: "I dare to ask senior, what kind of spiritual root is good?"
The young monk said: "The quality of spiritual root talent is related to its purity. Those with single-attribute spiritual roots are called heavenly spiritual roots in the practice world. They are extremely easy to cultivate and consume the least resources."
"Those with dual spiritual roots are called earth spiritual roots. They can be cultivated very quickly, but they are much inferior to those with heavenly spiritual roots."
"Those with three spiritual roots are ordinary spiritual roots. Most people are in this category. They need great opportunities to stand out from the crowd."
"As for the three spiritual roots and below, the four spiritual roots and the five spiritual roots, it goes without saying that these are called false spiritual roots and miscellaneous spiritual roots in the practice world."
"Those with false spiritual roots may be able to build a foundation if they have the chance to defy heaven."
"But for people with mixed spiritual roots, let alone building foundations, I'm afraid they will only be able to hover below the third level of Qi training in their lifetime."
Having said this, the young monk smiled slightly and said: "In short, the fewer spiritual root attributes, the better the talent."
"That's it."
Yue Qingshan nodded suddenly.
Han Lin looked calm, because he had already heard the withered-blooded old man talk about the spiritual root level as early as when he was at Cockcrow Temple.
It's just that the withered old man doesn't have the means to detect his spiritual roots, so he still doesn't know what kind of talent he has.
At this time, the young monk handed the jade mirror in his hand to Yue Qingshan: "This is the psychic treasure mirror for detecting the properties of spiritual roots. Put your hand on it."
"Yes, senior brother."
Upon hearing this, Yue Qingshan quickly stretched out his hand and gently placed it on the surface of the jade mirror.
Han Lin raised his eyes and saw that the beads around the jade mirror lit up one after another, first golden, then red, and finally brown.
But after three, there was no movement.
"The three spiritual roots of metal, wood, and earth are not good, but they are not the worst either." Seeing this, Zhang Xianchang smiled and nodded, looking quite satisfied.
"Senior, can my spiritual roots be cultivated in an exceptional way?" Yue Qingshan looked overjoyed and looked towards Zhang Xian.
"No, the three spiritual roots are just ordinary spiritual roots. They do not meet the conditions for special training. You have to start as a handyman disciple. However, if you are willing to work hard, there is still hope to build a foundation in this life!"
"That's it."
Yue Qingshan was slightly disappointed, then said firmly: "I will definitely work hard!"
"Yeah."
Zhang Xianchang nodded and said to the young monk: "Xiao He, hurry up and take the test for Han Lin. I'm a little tired. Please finish it early and go back to rest."
"Okay."
